name: Moriyama Ryousuke
source:
The calm and composed senior who is also known as the captain of the Fudan Football Team. Ryousuke's deliberate nature allows him to lead his teammates to victory. He's the type of person who will do anything to achieve his goal.

Ryousuke is a manipulative person who would go far enough to entrap his targets, making them do things to his bidding. And this time around, his target is his biggest rival, the ace player of the FudanShine Basketball Club, Hanajima Yoma. However, his motive to his new target remains a big mystery...

[From in-game profile]
